name: operator
purpose: Leases, idempotent dispatches confirmed by lookup, and holds
usedFor: Background work that writes to someone else's system on a person's behalf (bookings, requests, submissions), and any scheduled job that two processes might both try to run. Hand `Leases` any store with get, put and remove.
notFor: Conversations (they stay synchronous and answer from cached data), exactly-once delivery across systems that ignore idempotency keys, or scheduling itself (the app owns its clock and job list).
